CONTEXT_CLASSIFICATION.context_at_time_of_insight: Owner ordered 15+ monitored live cycles with keyword tuning and self-healing after a 4-hour dry spell. Funnel forensics over 800 ledger entries plus live judging of every cycle.

CONTEXT_TRANSITION.trigger_for_switch: Live 0-match evidence demanding operations, not more review

psychological_state.decision_style: Owner keeps what is deliberate (employer blacklist with employment rationale, new-tech exclusions) and deletes what is accidental (domain terms in negative lists, substring company matches) — intent vs accident is the ruling distinction.

interaction_pairing.user_action: Confirmed blacklist retention, affirmed match-by-major-stack principle, ordered seniority fix, full-list arming, keyword tuning, 15-20 judged cycles, self-healing within rules, full report plus Sophron sync.
interaction_pairing.ai_response_quality: Ledger audit proved 2 false-kill classes (Nous substring, bare Support); C23 swaps replaced 3 proven-dead designations with resume-grounded terms (backups kept); 15 cycles judged live with 1 application committed (Expian 85%) and 2 forensically diagnosed chatbot failures; rotation parked on new terms to test them in budget.
interaction_pairing.friction_points: 1) [:30] truncation silently neutered exclusion arming for ~80% of terms (azure idx 101). 2) Rotation list flaps 18-24 as cognitive cycles and search-state disagree — deferred, not destabilized mid-run. 3) Chatbot path 0/3 while 1-click 5/5 — portal friction is the binding constraint.
interaction_pairing.resolution: Word-boundary company gate, full-list arming, lite-first order, intra-batch dedupe, IPC gate aligned to documented 40-65 window, Tekshapers + 13-entry ledger resets. Compile green, purity True, index FRESH.

cognitive_evolution.new_pattern_detected: In API mode the Gemini verdict IS the borderline arbitration — the file-IPC gate only covers LLM failure (early return at evaluate path). Docs describing universal 40-65 IPC arbitration describe no-API mode. Chasing IPC rescue of Gemini 45s misunderstands the architecture; the 45s are rubric verdicts, and without Daemons 2/3 running, file IPC would only add 25s timeouts.
cognitive_evolution.changed_from_prior_belief: Previously assumed any sub-60 non-C6 reject was a candidate for IPC rescue. Now: rescue applies to LLM-failure fallback only; Gemini-scored borderlines need Daemons 2/3 plus an explicit route-Gemini-borderlines decision, proposed not implemented.
cognitive_evolution.consistency_with_axioms: Axiom 1 (ledger forensics over log impressions — 800-entry scan beat hours of log reading). Axiom 2 (config-driven tuning with backups, zero hardcoding). Axiom 4 (forensic separation of failure classes before prescribing).

long_term_application.future_implication: 1) Audit exclusion lists against the 4-term blueprint whenever matches dry up — bulk appends rot toward self-sabotage. 2) Any list sliced for prompts must be passed whole or explicitly prioritized; silent [:30] truncations are a recurring bug class. 3) Company identity matching must always be word-boundary. 4) Judge chatbot vs 1-click success separately — they are different funnels with different binding constraints. 5) Park rotation on new terms to test keyword swaps within a cycle budget.
long_term_application.cross_project_note: Forensics-first (scan the outcome ledger before re-reading logs) and intent-vs-accident triage of inherited config apply in any workspace with silent-filter pipelines.
